question: Which real-world pain point in a target niche has strong behavioral evidence and AI input-to-output feasibility worth building a startup MVP for?
trigger: Starting a new startup or micro-SaaS exploration in a domain or niche
Reviewing collected community complaints, software reviews, or freelance job posts to pick an MVP idea
Evaluating whether an AI product idea solves a fear-driven pain versus a low-priority desire
decision: Select one high-pain, high-willingness-to-pay problem clue to reframe into an AI MVP concept and validate with 10 target users
Discard low-pain vitamin/desire ideas or overcrowded generic wrappers before writing application code
evidence: Verbatim user complaints and manual workflow descriptions from Reddit, forums, or community discussions
1-to-3 star software reviews from Capterra or G2 highlighting clunky manual steps
Indie Hackers and Product Hunt launch threads showing validated micro-SaaS revenue and user questions
Repeated freelance job postings on Upwork or Fiverr showing tasks clients already pay humans to perform
success_measure: Produces a source-verified Clue Page (verbatim quote, context, AI input-to-output mapping, URL) and ranks candidates using the 5-criteria Easy-Vibe scorecard (Frequency, Pain Level, Current Workaround, Willingness to Pay, Market Size) plus need-tier classification
outcome: Generate a structured Easy-Vibe Clue Page, 5-Criteria Startup Idea Scorecard, and Reframed AI MVP Validation Plan in JSON and Markdown
input_types: Markdown or text notes of raw community complaints and job posts
output_artifacts: structured JSON startup idea scorecard and clue matrix
Markdown Clue Page and Reframed MVP Validation Plan
use_cases: 4-channel community and market clue hunting query generation
Easy-Vibe 20-minute Clue Page structuring with AI input-to-output mapping
5-criteria startup idea scoring and need-tier classification (pain vs gratification vs desire)
Horizontal user segmentation, vertical context timeline mapping, and MVP value reframing

examples.description: Analyze and rank freelance workflow clues into a startup scorecard and MVP validation plan

permissions_systems: Write local JSON and Markdown analysis reports
No external network access required in deterministic pipeline scripts

readiness_checks: Input JSON or text contains niche name and at least one raw clue or query request

permissions: Write local output JSON and Markdown files
